card.name: Ending of antipyrine, theophylline, digoxin
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug name that is split into parts, mainly antipyr|ine, theophyll|ine and Digox|in. It appears in drug-interaction text about clearance and enzyme effects.

modes.label: -ine endings
modes.description: The closing 'ine' of antipyrine or theophylline when these are used as test substrates for enzyme activity.
modes.example: Limited published data indicate that somatropin treatment increases cytochrome P450 (CYP450)-mediated antipyr<<ine>> clearance in man.

modes.label: Digoxin ending
modes.description: The closing 'in' of digoxin at the start of an interaction entry.
modes.example: Digox<<in>>: Measure serum digoxin concentrations before
